Name: Jamantha Jar
Author: KeroKii
Description:
A mod adding the amazing vtuber Jam_Jar_Head into the game!

The new girl in Stardew valley is a little stranger then the other townsfolk, but that won't stop her from living her best life in the valley.
Discover 4 different events as you grow closer to her, and watch her stroll around town creating chaos wherever she goes.
Who knows... she might even grow fond of you and come live at the farm!
